name: Common daisy
intro: A low perennial with a basal leaf rosette and yellow-centred heads edged in white or pink.
observe: Spoon-shaped leaves hug the ground. Flower stalks rise above the rosette.
habitat: Grows in sun or partial shade with good drainage. Cultivars vary in flower colour and form.
fact: Perennial describes its lifespan; an individual flower does not stay open forever.
